$comment: The saucer's looks, edited in the editor's Hangar tab. ufo, alien: the ones in the game. A UFO style: its skin (a name from saucer.skins in ufo.json), its dome, its guns (on or off), where the alien sits (`seat`, in saucer units: the disc's radius is 1), and its attachments (`pieces`: core/pieces/Pieces.ts). An alien: `root` (the whole alien moved, turned and sized in one go) and its pieces, in its own units (about 1 tall, standing at y 0, facing +Z).
